gramatica.titulo: Patterns: o que tem e onde está o equipamento

personagens.YARA: a Brazilian woman technician (thirties, brown skin, shoulder-length curly black hair, dark navy work shirt and pants)
personagens.FARMER: an older farmer (sixties, fair sunburned skin, short white hair and a full white beard, wide straw hat, light blue denim shirt and brown work pants)

gramatica.cenaAbertura: Wide view of a big farm on a sunny morning: next to a small white pickup truck, {YARA} shakes hands with {FARMER} in the yard, in front of a large machine shed, while green fields stretch behind them to the distant hills.

slides.cena: At the edge of a wide green soybean field, {FARMER} points at two green tractors parked far apart in the field, while {YARA} looks where he points, shading her eyes from the sun with one hand.

frases.en: **There is** a problem with the antenna.
frases.pt: Tem um problema com a antena.

frases.en: **There are** two tractors in the field.
frases.pt: Tem dois tratores no campo.

frases.en: **There is** a lot of dust on the screen.
frases.pt: Tem muita poeira na tela.

frases.en: **There are** some old cables in the cab.
frases.pt: Tem uns cabos velhos na cabine.

frases.en: During the harvest, **there are** ten people working here.
frases.pt: Na colheita, tem dez pessoas trabalhando aqui.

frases.en: **There is** only one road to the farm.
frases.pt: Só tem uma estrada até a fazenda.

slides.cena: In the middle of an open field, {YARA} holds her phone high above her head with a puzzled face, looking for a signal; the phone screen shows only a simple empty signal icon.

frases.en: **There isn't** a signal here.
frases.pt: Não tem sinal aqui.

frases.en: **Is there** a problem with the screen?
frases.pt: Tem algum problema com a tela?

frases.en: **Are there** other tractors on the farm?
frases.pt: Tem outros tratores na fazenda?

frases.en: **Is there** a big problem? No, **there isn't**.
frases.pt: Tem algum problema grande? Não, não tem.

frases.en: **Are there** many farms near here?
frases.pt: Tem muitas fazendas aqui perto?

frases.en: **There isn't** a GPS monitor in the old tractor.
frases.pt: Não tem monitor de GPS no trator velho.

slides.cena: Side view of a green tractor parked in a field: {YARA} sits inside the cab checking the GPS display, while a small round GPS antenna dome sits on the cab roof right above her.

frases.en: The monitor is **in** the cab.
frases.pt: O monitor fica na cabine.

frases.en: The antenna is **on** the roof.
frases.pt: A antena fica no teto.

frases.en: The screen **in** the cab is not turning on.
frases.pt: A tela da cabine não está ligando.

frases.en: The farmer is waiting for us **in** the field.
frases.pt: O produtor está esperando a gente na lavoura.

frases.en: Put the toolbox **on** the seat, please.
frases.pt: Coloca a caixa de ferramentas no banco, por favor.

frases.en: The field map is **on** the screen now.
frases.pt: O mapa da lavoura está na tela agora.

slides.cena: Inside the open cab of a green tractor, {YARA} kneels and lifts the driver's seat, finding a black cable under it, while {FARMER} stands next to the cab door, watching with curiosity.

frases.en: The cable is **under** the seat.
frases.pt: O cabo fica embaixo do banco.

frases.en: The tractor is **next to** the shed.
frases.pt: O trator está ao lado do galpão.

frases.en: I found the old cable **under** the floor mat.
frases.pt: Achei o cabo velho embaixo do tapete.

frases.en: Park your truck **next to** the house.
frases.pt: Estaciona a caminhonete ao lado da casa.

frases.en: The fuse box is **under** the dashboard.
frases.pt: A caixa de fusíveis fica embaixo do painel.

frases.en: Sit **next to** me, and I'll show you the screen.
frases.pt: Senta do meu lado que eu te mostro a tela.

revisao.en: **There is** a new screen in the cab.
revisao.pt: Tem uma tela nova na cabine.

revisao.en: **Is there** a signal in the field?
The owner is **in** the shed with the tractor.
revisao.pt: O dono está no galpão com o trator.

revisao.en: The toolbox is **next to** the tractor.
revisao.pt: A caixa de ferramentas está ao lado do trator.

gramatica.cenaRevisao: Late afternoon on a farmhouse porch: {YARA} and {FARMER} sit at a small wooden table with two cups of coffee, smiling and talking, while a green tractor stands next to a big shed in warm golden light.
